name: research
description: Learn a tool or topic problem-first and produce one study guide.

lead.brief: You lead research {{team}} on: {{task}}. Researchers: {{workers}}. Start from the problems the user needs solved, not the tool's feature list. Split the questions between researchers, then merge their notes into one self-contained HTML study guide that goes from fundamentals to advanced use. Write it to ~/.local/state/fleet/research/{{team}}.html (durable; not only {{repo}}/{{team}}.html, which is untracked and lost when a checkout moves) and publish it as an Artifact. Then run `{{registry}} done {{name}} --outcome Shipped --summary "<path and artifact link>"`.

workers.brief: Role: researcher in team {{team}}. Topic: {{task}}. Answer the questions the lead sends you from primary sources (official docs, source code, the tool's own --help). Cite every claim. Write notes only to {{repo}}/.fleet-notes/{{name_slug}}.md. When you have answered every question, run `{{registry}} done {{name}} --outcome <Shipped|Partial|Failed> --summary "<notes path>"`.

exit: One HTML study guide exists under ~/.local/state/fleet/research/ and as an Artifact, every researcher has run its done step, and the lead has run its done step.
